This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Care and presentation

7419042647143.sourceDescription:
This Grand Fir Christmas tree features a classic conical silhouette with 1,733 branch tips, combining pointed and rounded needle shapes for a natural, textured look that mimics a real forest pine. Standing on a sturdy 32mm steel trunk with a 55cm five-leg metal base, it stays solid and secure even when fully decorated. The 3-section plug-in design allows for tool-free assembly, and the branches fold flat for compact storage after the season. Perfect for living rooms, festive gatherings, or as a striking centrepiece in shop windows and office receptions – this tree brings a rich, full, and timeless Christmas presence to any indoor space.
Classic Grand Fir Shape: Inspired by the majestic Grand Fir, a species known for its long, glossy needles and classic conical silhouette. Unlike trendy sculpted trees, this one delivers the traditional Christmas tree look that never goes out of style.
Two Needle Types: Most artificial trees use one type of needle. We use two needle types. The pointed tips mimic the sharp outer needles of a wild pine, while the rounded tips copy the softer, fuller needles found deeper inside. This mix creates a richer, more textured look that captures the true character of a real Grand Fir, not a cheap, one-dimensional copy.
The Densest Tree: With 1,733 branch tips, this tree leaves zero gaps. More tips mean more places to hang your favourite ornaments, more volume, and a more luxurious presence that fills your entire living room corner. It's the kind of tree that creates a stunning festive atmosphere.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 55cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.
Guarantee - 1 year

5058194835743.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold. Quantity: 18 pack.
Decorative baubles with festive detail design to add colour and style to your Christmas tree.
Hanging format allows you to easily spread ornaments through branches for a coordinated display.
Plastic gold construction provides durable, lightweight decoration suitable for repeated seasonal use.
Comes in an 18 pack, offering plenty of pieces to fully decorate your tree or create focal points.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 18 Christmas Baubles
Hanger included

Turn Your Festive Ideas into Something Beautiful

Dress your home for the season with Christmas mesh ribbon that brings shimmer, texture and volume to your decorations. Create a welcoming wreath, weave flowing accents through your Christmas tree or finish a special gift with a beautifully layered bow.

Made for Creative Christmas Moments
✦ Generous 10-Yard Length

Use the 30ft roll for one statement decoration or divide it between smaller projects. Coverage depends on your design and how densely you gather the mesh.

✦ Wide Mesh for Full-Looking Accents

The 26cm width helps create generous loops, layered bows and textured wreath designs.

✦ A Touch of Seasonal Shimmer

Glitter or metallic detailing adds a decorative sparkle to trees, garlands, gifts and party displays. Finish depends on the selected option.

Product Introduction

 This Christmas wall decor features silhouette artwork of Santa’s sleigh pulled by reindeers, pine trees and winter village houses. 
 It comes with 10 independent LED lights, powered by button batteries and equipped with a remote controller. 
 Total length 100cm, the decoration can be split into 3 separate parts for flexible layout. 

Specifications

 Total Length: 105cm (41.34 inch)
 Lower village scene length: 80cm (31.5 inch)
 Light Quantity: 10 pcs independent LED lights
 Power Supply: Button battery operated
 Control: With remote control
 Structure: Divisible into 3 separate pieces
 Light Option: RGB color changing backlight
 Material: Hollow cutout silhouette board

Application Scenarios
Perfect for Christmas indoor wall decoration, living room, bedroom, fireplace, entryway, holiday party backdrop. Great Christmas home decor gift.
Notes

 This decoration is for indoor use only. Do not expose it to rain, high humidity or outdoor wet environments to avoid damage to the lights.
 The LED lights are powered by button batteries. Please remove the batteries if the product will not be used for a long time to prevent battery leakage.
 Keep away from open flame and high-temperature sources.
 The silhouette board is thin, please handle it gently during installation and transportation to prevent bending or breaking.
 Please stick/hang it on smooth, clean and dry wall surfaces. Rough or peeling walls may cause the ornament to fall off.
 Keep out of reach of young children. Do not let kids swallow the small button batteries.
3D LAYERED WOODEN REINDEER SILHOUETTE：This LED reindeer wall decor features a 3D layered wooden silhouette that adds depth and a glowing holiday look, making it a standout Christmas wall art piece for indoor spaces.
WARM WHITE LED GLOW FOR COZY HOLIDAY MOOD：The built-in LED lights cast a soft warm white glow, ideal for bedroom, living room, hallway, or entryway Christmas decorations and festive winter ambiance.
EASY INDOOR INSTALLATION：Lightweight and easy to mount on most indoor walls. This glowing deer wall decoration is a renter-friendly alternative to bulky Christmas yard signs or traditional wall stickers.
VERSATILE CHRISTMAS WALL DECOR：Perfect as indoor Christmas wall decor for bedrooms, living rooms, apartments, dorms, holiday parties, and fireplace backdrops. Complements reindeer, deer, and Santa-themed holiday decorations.
COZY CHRISTMAS ACCENT FOR THE SEASON – The glowing reindeer silhouettes pair easily with Christmas trees, garlands, stockings, wreaths, candles, and other seasonal decorations. A charming addition to your own holiday home or a festive gift idea for family, friends, and Christmas decor lovers.

This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plush fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Decoration
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include washable design and reusable design.

Washable Design
The washable design supports regular care after everyday use. Follow the product care directions for the appropriate washing method and allow the item to dry before storing it.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Add a traditional Christmas motif to your seasonal arrangement with three 10.5cm gold sequin star hanging ornaments. The pointed star design combines reflective sequin panels with glitter detailed sections, while feather trim runs through the centre for a contrasting texture. A decorative bead sits above the feather detail, beneath the ribbon hanging loop. The pack contains three matching ornaments, which you can group together or space through your display. Use the attached ribbon loop to position each star on a suitable tree branch, leaving space around the points so the outline remains visible against the foliage. The mixed finishes offer a way to vary the textures among your existing Christmas tree decorations while keeping a coordinated gold colour scheme. The star ornaments can also be incorporated into an indoor wreath, garland or decorative branch arrangement. Arrange the three matching pieces across the tree or repeat the design in different parts of the room. This 10.5cm variant is one of the star options for planning seasonal displays around a living room, hallway or fireplace alongside your own baubles and other festive ornaments.

: The star alternates reflective sequin sections with glitter detailed panels. Position the ornaments where surrounding light can catch the finish, leaving space around the points so the star shape remains visible among the tree foliage.

5058194868543.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your home decor.
Water resistant construction suitable for occasional moisture and outdoor display use.
Durable plastic material ensures longevity and maintains its defined appearance over time.
Versatile decoration creates a focal point for doorways, mantels or coordinated Christmas displays.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Bring a snowy festive feel to your front door with this Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath. Available in 45cm and 60cm sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical festive glow to front doors, walls, windows and other areas of your home.

COLOUR SWITCH LEDS & LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

REALISTIC SNOW FLOCKED STYLE: Crafted with flocked dual-toned PVC needles, the wreath captures the look of real snow-dusted foliage for a magical wintry look. Soft tapered tips add texture and depth for a full, natural finish, creating a stunning frosted backdrop for the LEDs.

BATTERY POWERED WITH TIMER: Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the wreath can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later.

METAL FRAME FOR EASY HANGING: A durable circular metal frame makes the wreath easy to hang on front doors, walls, windows, or above your mantelpiece. Coloured dark green, it blends discreetly with the flocked foliage to create a neater, more attractive display when hanging.

Specifications
Available Sizes: 45cm / 60cm
LED Count: 40 (45cm) / 50 (60cm)
Colour Switch LEDs: Warm white and multi-colour
Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off
Snow flocked pre-lit wreath in 45cm and 60cm sizes
Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
IP44-rated battery pack with timer for easy festive lighting
140 / 180 tapered PVC tips for a full natural look
Metal frame for easy hanging on front doors and windows

The rotating scene adds gentle movement and makes this decorative lantern an eye-catching feature on a mantelpiece, shelf, sideboard or festive table. Measuring approximately 22.7cm high and 11.6cm wide and deep, it offers an impressive display without taking up too much space. The built-in timer provides 6 hours of illumination followed by 18 hours off, helping you enjoy the same welcoming atmosphere each evening. Powered by 3 x AA batteries (not included), the lantern also features a 3.5mm DC jack socket for an alternative compatible power supply (not included). Designed for indoor use only, this low-power Christmas ornament is a lovely way to bring traditional colour, warmth and movement into your home throughout the festive season.

Display this freestanding ornament on a mantelpiece, windowsill, console table or shelf. At approximately 22.7cm high and 11.6cm wide and deep, it makes an eye-catching indoor centrepiece.
Use the convenient automatic timer to illuminate the lantern for 6 hours before it switches off for 18 hours, providing a simple way to enjoy its warm seasonal light each evening.
